producer_report.summary: Added docs/ontology.toml with the seven seeded terms (planning, job, Athena, Hermes, product versus system, landed, Sri). Each has a definition, the misread that caused it, sources (existing paths or decision ids) and relations to defined terms. Hermes has two senses with their own sources: Hermes Agent (not part of Olympus or Athena) and Hermes the Orchestration god (part of Olympus). Athena is a role within the system, and Sri owns it. Added crates/athena-cli/tests/ontology.rs, which parses the real file and has in-memory negative tests for a missing sources field, a non-existent source, a dangling relation and a duplicate term. Added decision D109, a CHANGELOG entry and an architecture.md bullet. decision-links.toml needed no change: D109 supersedes and amends nothing, and appending to decisions.md shifts no existing line. Cargo.toml and Cargo.lock needed no change either, because toml and serde were already dependencies. One existing xtask policy test still fails on files I did not touch (see open_issues).

checks_run.note: Everything passes, including the 7 new ontology tests, except xtask policy test athena_refers_to_no_one_who_runs_it_or_where. It flags the word operator at docs/design/job-planning.md lines 6, 127 and 199. That file is unchanged by this job.
Ran `cargo fmt --all` (applies formatting) after writing; the check form itself was not run.

criteria_check.criterion: docs/ontology.toml defines the seven terms (planning, job, Athena, Hermes, product versus system, landed, Sri). Each has a definition, the misread that caused it, a sources field naming paths or decision ids that exist, and relations whose targets are all defined terms.
criteria_check.evidence: Test the_real_ontology_is_valid_and_has_the_seven_terms passes; it checks that the seven names are present and runs the validator on the real file.

criteria_check.criterion: The Hermes entry names both senses: Hermes Agent (second studied system, Part 2 S1, not part of Athena) and Hermes as the Orchestration god in the Olympus Pantheon (BRIEF.md). It says which is part of Olympus and cites a source for each. Every 'not part of' claim has a source.
criteria_check.evidence: The Hermes term has two [[term.senses]] with part_of_olympus false and true, each with sources (BRIEF.md, strategy-view.md). The test validates sense sources and asserts both flags.

criteria_check.criterion: Relations match Olympus: the system is Olympus, Athena is the strategy and learning role within it, Sri owns Olympus (Zeus). No relation makes Athena the whole system.
criteria_check.evidence: Athena has role_within targeting 'product versus system'; Sri has owns; test athena_is_a_role_within_the_system_and_never_the_whole passes.

criteria_check.criterion: The file states a term is added only when it causes a misread and says how a check reads it (parse path and fields). Landed means merged on main through a verified pull request. The Sri term says use the name or 'they', never he or she, and cites job 20261017-173504-91ys.
criteria_check.evidence: The header comment of docs/ontology.toml has the rules and the parse path and fields. The landed definition says merged on main through a verified pull request. The Sri definition gives the name-or-they rule; its misread names job 20261017-173504-91ys, and the test asserts this.

criteria_check.criterion: docs/decisions.md has a new entry keeping the ontology, citing the Olympus 2026-10-17 decision sheet (decision 5), listing alternatives (no ontology; per-study glossaries only), and stating studies keep their own concept model so firstmate, Hermes Agent and Athena are compared in the same terms. docs/decision-links.toml is updated if required, and CHANGELOG.md has an entry.
criteria_check.evidence: D109 added at the end of docs/decisions.md with those contents. CHANGELOG [Unreleased] has an Added entry. decision-links.toml is not required: D109 has no supersede or amend phrase and no existing line moved.

criteria_check.criterion: Run `cargo test`: the new ontology test passes on docs/ontology.toml, and in-memory unit tests show failure for a missing sources field, a non-existent source, a dangling relation target, and a duplicate term. `cargo clippy` is clean and `cargo fmt --check` passes.
criteria_check.evidence: cargo test output shows the 7 ontology tests passing, including the four negative tests. Clippy is clean. `cargo fmt --all` was run, but the check form was not run. Full `cargo test --locked` still has one failure, in a file this job did not touch.

criteria_check.criterion: No secrets or personal data, including the user's email address, appear in any new or changed file.
criteria_check.evidence: No email, credential or personal data was written. I used the words 'Sri' and 'they' as the brief directs.

learnings: toml and serde (with derive) are already dependencies of athena-cli, so Cargo.toml and Cargo.lock need no change.
docs/decision-links.toml only lists supersession and amend hits, keyed by line number in decisions.md; appending a decision at the end needs no entry.
A tracked file in the base commit already fails the boundary scan (docs/design/job-planning.md), so the full test run fails before any change.
